name: io.github.zbooroll-droid/zboryx-services
description: Crypto data for bots: DEX execution cost, API health, USDC reconciliation. x402 pay-per-call.

tools.name: zboryx_dossier
tools.description: Before a DEX trade: executable round-trip cost (Kyber quotes, gas included) at your size + token safety codes (honeypot / tax / GoPlus). Base, Arbitrum, BNB Chain. Price: 0.02 USDC (x402, Base) per call; 3 free calls per day. When the free trial is used up the result is an x402 offer: sign it and call again with x_payment.

explain.description: set to "1" to add a short AI explanation of the result

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload (the X-PAYMENT header value) once the free daily calls are used

tools.name: zboryx_apimon
tools.description: Health of public crypto data providers (DexScreener, GeckoTerminal, Helius, public RPCs, Hyperliquid…) from live production traffic: error and 429 rates, latency, status. Price: 0.01 USDC (x402, Base) per call; 3 free calls per day. When the free trial is used up the result is an x402 offer: sign it and call again with x_payment.

explain.description: set to "1" to add a short AI explanation of the result

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload (the X-PAYMENT header value) once the free daily calls are used

tools.name: zboryx_recon
tools.description: USDC receipts on Base for an address: confirmed transfers with unique ids, deterministic matching against your invoices (matched / ambiguous / partial / missing / unidentified), JSON or CSV.
